name: auth.md-client
description: Agentic registration for services that support the auth.md protocol: authenticate, complete claim ceremonies, and make authenticated requests.

tools.name: authmd_authenticate
tools.description: Authenticate to an auth.md-capable service; returns credentials or claim ceremony materials.

tools.name: authmd_complete_claim
tools.description: Complete a claim ceremony with the code the user read back from the claim page.

tools.name: authmd_fetch
tools.description: Make an authenticated HTTP request with automatic credential refresh.
